intent: Every engine drives a browser through one interface that tells the truth about what was applied.
change: BrowserProvider interface with SessionMeta echo contract, withBrowser() release guarantee, LocalProvider on plain Playwright chromium, the provider contract test suite, and CI wiring (chromium install) so the suite runs on every push.
done_when: Contract suite green on LocalProvider in pnpm check locally and in CI; withBrowser proven to release on success, on thrown error, and idempotently on double release; SessionMeta echoes not-applied options honestly.

intent: Encode every Solari sharp edge once, behind the seam, so no engine is ever written against wrong vendor assumptions.
change: SolariProvider on @solarisdk/browser launch() with maxAttempts:1 and provider-owned retry, self-tracked session ledger with failed-release retention, option mapping with cross-field preflight, degradation echoes (proxy presence/tier, timezoneId, storageState tri-state), typed error taxonomy (429 non-retryable, 5xx retryable, 402/428 config), and dispose() ordering solari.close after releases.
done_when: Mocked-transport unit tests prove single-create-on-timeout, create/release/dispose ordering, ledger add/remove/retention, unproxied echo when the response omits proxy, 429 mapped non-retryable, and proxy-without-stealth preflight rejection; contract suite compiles against SolariProvider.

intent: A real vendor round-trip proves the adapter works and becomes the standing early-warning line for vendor drift.
change: @live-tagged vitest suite plus a GitHub Actions workflow (nightly schedule + manual dispatch, secrets-gated): recorded fast-pool session, stable public page assertion, rrweb flush pause, release, replay-URL poll through 404s (~30s), replay decompression finding recorded in code, empty-ledger assert, dispose; missing SOLARI_API_KEY yields an explicit skipped status.
done_when: One workflow run with the secret is green end-to-end including replay retrieval and the empty-ledger assert; one run without the secret reports skipped, not green; both runs linked from the sprint PR.
